title: A morning nudge on recovery days
hypothesis: On mornings when WHOOP has a fresh recovery, a short nudge to spend the day's energy deliberately lifts same-evening mood and next-morning HRV compared with mornings that carry no nudge.

arms.name: treatment
arms.instruction: Your recovery is in. Pick one thing today that deserves your energy and give it a proper go. Mark Done tonight if you did.

notes: Health domain. The nudge is shown on Home and as the day's card. recall.mood is the one-tap mood at that evening's wrap-up, so offset_days 0 is the same day. HRV and recovery are dated to the next morning, so offset_days 1.
